title: Lemon blueberry baked oats

items: 1 tsp butter or nonstick spray, for the dish
1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries (don't thaw frozen ones)

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F with a rack in the middle. Grease the baking dish.
Mash the banana in the bowl with a fork until mostly smooth. Whisk in the eggs, milk, yogurt, maple syrup and lemon zest until combined.
Stir in the oats, baking powder and salt. Fold in the blueberries, then spread the mixture evenly in the dish.
Bake 25–30 min, until the top is golden, the edges pull away from the dish and the center is set and doesn't jiggle (160°F in the middle).
Cool 10 min before cutting into 4 squares, so it firms up.
tips: Use old-fashioned rolled oats. Quick oats turn pasty and steel-cut oats won't soften in time.
For a glaze, whisk ½ cup powdered sugar with 1 Tbsp lemon juice and drizzle it over the cooled oats.
Bake it on Sunday and reheat a square each morning.
storage: Fridge up to 5 days, covered. Freeze squares wrapped individually up to 3 months. Reheat in the microwave 45–60 sec, or 1½–2 min from frozen.
